title: Myth vs Fact: Chemical Drain Cleaners Clear Heavy Clogs
description: Many homeowners and property managers rely on liquid chemical drain cleaners as a quick fix for stubborn line blockages. However, caustic chemicals often fail to clear full obstructions caused by grease, roots, or dense hair mats. Worse, standing caustic liquids generate intense heat through exothermic reactions, which can soften PVC piping, degrade rubber seals, and corrode older metal traps. For professional plumbers, chemical residues also create severe burn hazards during cable auger operations. Mechanical clearing methods, such as drain snakes or hydro-jetters, remain the safe and definitive standard for removing drainage blockages.

Myth vs Fact: Chemical Drain Cleaners Clear Heavy Clogs

Many homeowners and property managers rely on liquid chemical drain cleaners as a quick fix for stubborn line blockages. However, caustic chemicals often fail to clear full obstructions caused by grease, roots, or dense hair mats. Worse, standing caustic liquids generate intense heat through exothermic reactions, which can soften PVC piping, degrade rubber seals, and corrode older metal traps. For professional plumbers, chemical residues also create severe burn hazards during cable auger operations. Mechanical clearing methods, such as drain snakes or hydro-jetters, remain the safe and definitive standard for removing drainage blockages.
